Title: Register new instructor (no email verification)
Steps: Register as instructor; land on dashboard
Expected Result: Account created and dashboard accessible without email verify

Title: Upload national ID card image
Steps: Open identity page; upload valid image; submit

Title: Cannot publish while ID pending
Preconditions: Instructor uploaded ID; admin not approved yet
Steps: Create draft course; open publish tab

Title: Admin approves ID in verifications queue
Steps: Admin opens queue; finds instructor; clicks Approve

Title: Can publish after admin approval
Steps: Open publish tab; click Submit for review
